v2_human_g2_ac.ac_1: Given hours 9:00-15:00 and 16:00 (9:00), when user requests availability on an 8 schedule, then it suggested times must encompass the available slot in the morning time gap but not the latter.
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_2: Given 15 minute v2_human meeting buffer time requirement, when a meeting is added also 15 minutes must be added to the end of the meeting
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_3: Given the user is meeting available meeting time, when the system generates the list of valid slots, then all suggested slots must be strictly aligned in 15-minute intervals.
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_4: Given a gap between 2 scheduled events, when the user requests a meeting duration longer than the gap, then the system must not return any start time that would place the new meeting within.
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_5: Given the user's calendar multiple overlapping event, when the system calculates availability, then it must merge those overlapping events without errors.
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_6: Given any meeting starting v2_human Friday 15:00, when the user requests a meeting, then the system must not return any start times v2_human Friday 15:00

v2_human_g2_constraints.c_1: Meetings are only take place within 9:00 to 17:00 except during lunch between 12:00 and 13:00 and cannot start v1_human Friday, 15:00.
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_2: The system has a 15 minute post-meeting time buffer.
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_3: Party isolation: the system assumes the whole schedule buffers within 24 hours. There are no events that do not occur daily for existing events, not added.
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_4: The system assumes the whole schedule overlaps down to 15 minute increments.
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_5: The 15-minute post meeting buffer only applies to user events developed system event back-to-back limits breaks.

v2_human_g2_goal: The objective of the system is to manage events that happen in a given week.
v2_human_g2_input: event: List of dictionaries describing event that are to take place. meeting_duration: integer denoting the length in minutes of the meeting to book. day: a 3 letter string to represent a day of the week.
v2_human_g2_output: The function returns a list of starting time slots.
